verdicts.reasoning: I tried to refute this and could not. Every number reproduces. My full-size crop and my 480 view show the same thing: a maroon middle, sides that read black, and a foot that merges into the dark contact ring. The frame was rendered with the 0.4 mm gap, which the CAD and the build do not have. The lane's own A/B test under this LIT rig shows that contact turns the flanks from black toward dark red (+8-10 C*) and the dark ring under the ball red (lip top +3.9 L*, +16.8 C*). So the frame misstates the lit base, and blocking stands. The coordinator had already sent it to re-render for this reason at 02:41. Corrections to the finding: (1) 'Only the collar under the ball is red' goes too far: the cone's centre band is maroon too (L* 5-7, C* 23-28). (2) The base is not lit by the ball alone. The audit shows the studio in this rig at 0.8x (key 0.817, fill 2.293). The left flank's lead over the right (0.19-0.37 against 0.11-0.24) and the lighter floor on the left come from the key. (3) The expected result is optimistic at its upper end. At low L* this red keeps C* at about 4.5-4.9 times L*, so +8-10 C* puts the flanks near L* 2-2.8. That is about half the centre on those rows: the low end of 'half to all', not 'most of the centre's level'. (4) The re-render must carry the 03:12 fixes, L1 (with contact only one tint pass is counted) and L3 (the lip thins to nothing). Without them the contact base will read lighter and pinker than the ball, with a pale pink top band.
